lines.text: We breathe the air of a morning unwritten
Where the red soil remembers the strength of the past
Like the mist on the mountains, our spirits awaken
To a future where healing and harmony last
Thula, lizwe lethu, kukhanya kwelanga
lines.translation: Be still, our land, the sun shines

lines.text: Nyika yedu yose yava nerunyararo
lines.translation: Our whole land now has peace

lines.text: We are the pulse of the earth, wild and free
Bound by the spirit of unity
Mumvuri wenyeredzi, simba remadzinde
lines.translation: In the shadow of stars, the strength of our roots

lines.text: Isizwe esihle, esilethemba
lines.translation: A beautiful nation filled with hope

lines.text: We trace the rivers that run to the sea
Carrying grace for the ages to be
Thula, lizwe lethu, kukhanya kwelanga
lines.translation: Be still, our land, the sun shines

lines.text: Nyika yedu yose yava nerunyararo
lines.translation: Our whole land now has peace

lines.text: We are the pulse of the earth, wild and free
Bound by the spirit of unity
Lumina…
Vuka…
Simuka…
Thula, lizwe lethu, kukhanya kwelanga

lines.text: Nyika yedu yose yava nerunyararo
lines.translation: Our whole land now has peace

lines.text: We are the pulse of the earth, wild and free
Bound by the spirit of unity
In the quiet of dawn, a new land is born
Guided by truth, by grace, by the light
